cupertino.notes: ROUND 74 (h): compared to Flutter CupertinoButton (shapes only, own measurement, light): the Flutter-equivalent size is the large variant: ours 112 x 50 r12.2 against ref filled 86 x 52 r12.6 (width is the label, Roboto against ours; height 50 is the UIKit large configuration, Flutter 52 comes from its padding and Roboto line height); fills filled 007aff equal at rest. The default medium button is 94 x 34 r9.4 (UIButton.Configuration medium) and has no Flutter counterpart: kept per round 26 and HIG, whose 44 pt minimum is a touch-target rule that the visible button does not need to fill (AppKit regular is 22); the pointer area is the 34 px box, no hit slop (recorded). Deviations: tinted ours 15 percent tint (light cee0f8 on f2f2f7) against Flutter 12 percent on white (e0efff), dark about 22 percent against 26 percent; pressed darkens (iOS) where Flutter fades to 40 percent opacity; disabled fills are grey on our ground (dcdce2) against Flutter's flat efeff0; ground differences as flutter-compare-h.md.
